recipe.visualDefinition: A soft-focus, desaturated outdoor portrait of a man in a red turtleneck sitting on a stool in a field of tall grass, characterized by a muted 1970s color palette and prominent script typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered vertically with a slight offset to the right
High-contrast red sweater against a desaturated, hazy background
Typography anchored to the top corners, framing the subject's head
Low-angle perspective creating a sense of stature despite the seated pose
coreInvariants: Muted earth tones (beige, brown, faded green)
Heavy grain texture consistent with vintage film stock

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body seated portrait, occupying the central vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vibrant red turtleneck sweater serves as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the red sweater, move up to the face, then outward to the script titles in the top corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample soft-focus background space in the upper left and right quadrants for text placement.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated beige and muted green (background environment)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation on the subject, low saturation and high value (brightness) in the background to create depth through atmospheric perspective.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavyweight formal script and clean sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Display text features thick-to-thin stroke transitions
High-looping ascenders and descenders in the script
Body text is a tight, geometric sans-serif for legibility
characterSpecificRedesigns: Connected lowercase letters in the script titles
Tight kerning in the tracklist block

typesetting.alignment: Left and Right justified to corners

composition.position: Upper left quadrant below display title

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a decorative, organic script with a functional, rigid sans-serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the mid-century casual script energy
Matches the tight, utilitarian feel of the tracklist

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A 1970s style film photograph of a man with a beard and brown hair wearing a bright red turtleneck sweater. He is sitting on a dark stool in a field of tall, dry, beige grass. The lighting is soft and hazy with a slight sepia tint and visible film grain. The background is out of focus.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a bold, warm-brown script title in the top left and top right corners. Below the top-left title, add a vertical list of text in a small, dark-brown condensed sans-serif font, left-aligned.

verificationChecks: Is the sweater a vibrant, saturated red?
Is the background sufficiently desaturated and hazy?
Is the script font bold and calligraphic?
Is the tracklist text condensed and tightly spaced?

mustRedesign: Specific brand logos in the top left corner
Exact facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red sweater doesn't bleed into the background
Check that the grain texture is uniform across the image
Verify the script text is legible against the hazy background
Confirm the subject's pose feels relaxed and natural
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-saturation central subject with a low-saturation, high-key environment, framed by corner-anchored vintage script and condensed sans-serif typography.
